answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a scarce, physically attested thermal credential, much as a reentry beacon must survive the ablation horizon to certify a genuine vehicle rather than a sparrow-like decoy. Staked identities broadcast periodic proof-of-work beacons whose ablation kinetics are cross-checked against independent sensor quorums, so forged. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
